name: Smart Analysis
tagline: AI-Powered Policy Analysis & Smart Content Generation System.

data.title: Transforming Data into Strategic Narratives in Minutes
data.description: Smart Analysis is a 'Policy Content Factory' that helps leaders respond to critical issues instantly. Powered by AI, it analyzes raw data and automatically generates executive reports, media releases, and public communication drafts without starting from scratch.

features.title: Multi-Audience Content Generator
features.desc: One-click transformation of raw data into various formats: Executive Reports for Leaders, Press Releases for Media, or Simplified Narratives for the Public.

features.title: AI Request & Brainstorming
features.desc: A virtual assistant ready to discuss the impacts of regional phenomena (e.g., inflation or disasters) to enrich your policy perspective.

features.title: Early Warning & Spatial Detection
features.desc: Interactive maps that detect real-time field anomalies and immediately trigger the system to prepare initial analysis drafts.

features.title: Standardized Reporting
features.desc: Automatically generates documents with layouts and language structures that comply with government administrative standards.

items.title: 90% Reduction in Response Time
items.desc: The process of drafting analyses and reports that usually takes 5-7 hours can now be completed in under 10 minutes.

items.title: Objectivity & Analytical Accuracy
items.desc: AI minimizes cognitive bias and human error in translating raw figures, ensuring every policy is built on solid, verified facts.

items.title: Precise Cross-Audience Communication
items.desc: Eliminates miscommunication by automatically adjusting the tone, whether for managerial levels (Regents) or public media releases.

items.title: Focus on Execution, Not Administration
items.desc: Leaders and analysts are no longer exhausted by drafting words from scratch, allowing full focus on solving problems in the field.

items.q: Is the AI-generated content safe and accurate for government use?
items.a: Yes. The AI acts as a drafting assistant. It composes narratives based on hard data inputted from regional systems, and users retain full control to edit (manual review) before documents are downloaded or distributed.

items.q: How does the system adjust the report's language style?
items.a: The system is trained with formal administrative and journalistic linguistic standards. Users can toggle audience settings: 'Media Release' uses an inverted pyramid journalistic style, while 'Executive Report' uses a formal executive summary style.

items.q: Who are the primary users of this application?
items.a: It is specifically designed for Managerial and Executive levels: Heads of Planning Agencies (BAPPEDA/BRIDA), Department Heads, Government Spokespersons, or Senior Policy Analysts.
